links.surface: أَبُو نَصْرٍ أَحمَد بْنُ الْحُسَيْنِ الضَّبِّيُّ

notes: «قَالَ سَمِعْتُ» makes أَبَا بَكْرٍ the source of the story (rule 5)
The story is Abu Bakr's own account, so he is the last link; «وَمَالَقِيتُ أَنْصَبَ مِنْهُ» is an aside, left out
The Imam al-Rida appears only as the place of the shrine, not as a speaker, so he is not a link

levels.surface: أبو نصر أحمد بن الحسين الضبي

notes: «قال سمعت أبا بكر الحمامي الفراء» makes Abu Bakr a link (rule 5). His own account («أودعني بعض الناس وديعة») is the saying, so he is the last link. The depositor, the owner of the deposit and the man in the dream are in the scene only.
The leading «3-» is the report number, not part of a surface.
